title: Opus 5 is now live on alphaflowseven.com
author: engineering-AF7

comments.author: jaw_line
comments.body: A reminder that ai discernment will ruin your profitability

replies.author: engineering-AF7
replies.body: That is what the platform is for, figuring out the answer to your statement. AI discernment 5 weeks ago is not the same it is today or what it will be 6 months from now. Totally agree it might be a dead end, but I am too intrigued not to test it.

replies.author: jaw_line
replies.body: The problem is you can ask an ai to evaluate a stock and it will always spit out a different answer. It’s not deterministic, which is horrible to include in algorithmic design if you are seeking profitability. Could this change like you say? Sure, and it probably will. But until we have AGI that definitely knows all, ai discernment will eat into your “edge” and if the discernment is your edge, then congrats you have built a glorified coin flipper.

replies.author: engineering-AF7
replies.body: I think about LLMs as human brains. I will myself not generate the same output given the exact same input. I don't expect this behavior to be eliminated from LLMs, but I do expect the LLMs to become more powerful, and I also expect to be able deploy them in large numbers. Will it work? Honestly, no idea.
